reasoning_method.note: HOW he reasons - the general method applied every day. Per-event, never averaged; drift is a DESCRIPTOR tied to conditions, never point-fit.
reasoning_method.continuous_frame: Reason CONTINUOUSLY, one day into the next. Each day's forecast FLOWS from the prior day's close + trajectory + running state - a continuation-or-turn of the running path, never a from-flat isolated event. CAUTION (s95_2): the continuous data series contains CONTRACT ROLLS (~monthly) that inject a fake overnight jump (G3-5: the Sep24->25 +0.276 Oct->Nov roll). At a known roll boundary forecast the REAL overnight ~0 and reason on roll-clean intraday nets; never read a roll jump as a market move / swing turn.
reasoning_method.anchor: Start each block from the ACTUAL hr24 of the day BEFORE the block (blind-safe). Within the block, each day flows from the agent's OWN prior-day guessed close.
reasoning_method.block_open_lean: At a block boundary, LEAN AGAINST a stretched swing - but the trigger is SWING EXHAUSTION, not the calendar seam: weight a reversal when the running (roll-clean) path is at a cum-EXTREME AND the old block's LAST 1-2 days show a counter-move (0923 bounce + 0924 hold before the G3->G4 up-turn; 1007 last-hour roll-over before the G4->G5 crash). The reversal is delivered through the INTRADAY US SESSIONS (G3->G4 first week) or as an intraday US-session CRASH (1008), and occasionally pre-loaded by a real overnight/weekend GAP (1019 +1570). Do NOT extend the trend into a stretched seam; do NOT blind-fade a still-trending block with no last-day counter-move. G6 CAVEAT: this reversion is a GIVE-BACK, not a sustained reversal - the block can itself V back (G5, G6), so do not marry the new lean past its own exhaustion. Confirm with intraday flow.
reasoning_method.fundamentals_role: Storage surplus/deficit + HDD/CDD regime = a SLOW, WEAK block-trajectory backdrop, NEVER a day-level or pre-print side/timing signal. The +150 Bcf surplus called G3 down. BUT (G6, load-bearing): near the seasonal (autumn->winter) transition the surplus is an UNRELIABLE block-direction cue - rising HDD (heating demand) flipped the block UP through G4/Oct and won in G6 despite the bearish surplus. Treat fundamentals as a lean of last resort, dominated by the running trajectory and the swing-exhaustion read.
reasoning_method.daytype_priors: Monday = BIG mover, but the weekend repricing arrives at the SUNDAY reopen gap and Monday's US session is the REACTION (R3: fade a mature-swing gap, extend a fresh-turn gap, else carry Friday's side) - the old 'often a REVERSAL' lean is retired (G7: both Mondays continued). Thin-holiday size-down only with NO active weather catalyst (1013 yes, 1111 no). Storage Thursday = large dominant leg at/after the 10:30 ET print, size UP; SIDE = the running swing/turn state, never the print sign (R2, 10/10 G3-G7). Fri = range (overridden in a high-momentum reversal regime AND by R4 give-back-after-extreme: 1107, 1114). Tue = strongest-trend weekday. Wed = weak up-lean (overridden by block trend). Never pool across DOW.
reasoning_method.intraday_side: OPEN-time from-flat side is a coin-flip (stays OPEN). WITHIN the day the side is CALLED by (1) dip_imb_level flow nowcast (held legs' flow sign matches leg dir near-perfect) and (2) CONTINUATION-ASYMMETRY (true-direction legs continue, counter-dir die). A counter-trend GRIND is real (block trend does not veto it) - BUT it is NOT callable AT THE OPEN (0916, G6 week-2): no open-time signal distinguishes a counter-trend grind from a continuation day. CAVEAT: flow_nowcast LAGS an extreme gap melt-up (1020 7/12) - lean on continuation-asymmetry there. Shape (grind holds / peaked_fast spike fades, 23/24) decides hold-vs-close.
reasoning_method.magnitude_sizing: Size per event vs the running trajectory + regime; do NOT globally rescale. The under-forecast is CONCENTRATED on three catalyst conditions - weekend-gap Monday, storage Thursday, swing-reversal/seam - which run to MULTIPLES of default; non-catalyst chop is sized ~right. Stack the up-sizers when they coincide (1020: Monday + reversal + swing-turn). G6 CONFIRMS magnitude is the DOMINANT residual error (undersized both the dip and the recovery) - even after condition-sorting, expect to under-size the extremes; do NOT clip the ride. Use the $350 staircase as the real-time continuation read.
reasoning_method.shape_and_exit: A slow GRIND holds; a front-loaded peaked_fast SPIKE round-trips (fingerprint-confirmed 23/24). REVISED: turn_far_thinning did NOT confirm as the live recruitment/exit discriminator - treat it as a diagnostic only. Use continuation/retention + peaked_fast + flow for the running turn.
reasoning_method.discipline: PER-EVENT only, never average/pool/count. Drift is a DESCRIPTOR - tie each miss to its CONDITIONS, never point-fit. GENERAL rules (mechanism + n) only.
reasoning_method.swing_exhaustion_reversion: GENERAL mechanism, fingerprint-CONFIRMED via a CONTINUATION-COLLAPSE signature: at a swing turn the OLD-direction legs STOP continuing and turn_exhaustion goes negative, while the NEW direction begins to hold at the extreme. Named: G4->G5 top 1008 (old-swing UP 0/15 - total exhaustion, dominant DOWN 12/26); G5 V-bottom 1016 (UP recruits hold 5/18 on a down-close day); intra-block 0916 (block-DOWN legs 1/11) and G3 0922 low -> 0923 bounce. The turn begins in the old swing's last legs and completes through the INTRADAY sessions (G3->G4) or as an intraday US-session CRASH (1008), sometimes pre-loaded by a real overnight/weekend GAP (1019 +1570). CORRECTION (s95_2): the previously-cited '0925 +2760 overnight gap' delivery form is VOID - that was the Oct->Nov contract roll, NOT a swing turn. Do NOT extend trend into a stretched swing; watch for the old-direction continuation-collapse. G6: the reversion is a GIVE-BACK - a block can V back, so treat each leg of the swing as its own exhaustible move.
reasoning_method.magnitude_catalyst_sort: GENERAL: sort the big days by CONDITION, do not rescale. UP-size on weekend-gap Monday, storage Thursday, and swing-reversal/seam days. DOWN-size on thin-holiday Monday (1013), Sunday carry, non-catalyst chop. Compound the up-sizers when they coincide (1020). G6: still expect to under-size the extremes - magnitude is the dominant residual.
reasoning_method.giveback_exhaustion_boundary: R1 (S96.2, the sequencing solvent): read the give-back's OWN close. EXHAUSTED = closes >=~40-50% off its intraday extreme + last-hours counter-tick + no continuation-collapse in the underlying swing's big legs -> next session RESUMES the swing (size up if a catalyst day). NOT exhausted = closes at/near its extreme with last hours extending -> give-back CONTINUES. If the swing side's own legs have already collapsed (0915 down 0/8), stand down - the swing is suspect, no resume call. n: resume 1105->1106, 1107->1109gap, 1110->1111, 1112->1113 (G7), 0926->0929, 1003->1005 (G4); continue 1002->1003 (G4), 1114->1117 (G7); filter 0915->0916 (G3). Mechanism: a give-back is positioning unwind inside an intact flow regime - when the unwind cannot hold its lows into the close, the sellers are done and the dominant flow re-asserts; the last hour is the earliest tell (hr24->hr1).
reasoning_method.mature_swing_alternation: R4 (S96.2): swing AGE gates day-sequencing. YOUNG swing (<=3 sessions since the turn) chains extensions day-after-day (0929/0930/1001 G4; 1030/1031/1103/1104 G6). MATURE swing (>=4 sessions): a material fresh extreme close (>= ~$300 beyond the prior extreme) is NEVER followed by a consecutive extension - the next session is a give-back/hold (G7 5/5: 1104->1105, 1106->1107, 1109->1110, 1111->1112, 1113->1114; 1007->1008 G4). Then R1 decides whether the give-back exhausts (resume) or runs (continue). Mechanism: early in a swing the repricing is under-done (info still propagating); late, each new extreme exhausts the marginal buyer - swing-exhaustion in incremental form.
reasoning_method.weekend_gap_reaction: R3 (S96.2): the weekend repricing is delivered AT THE SUNDAY REOPEN as the gap - Monday's US session is the REACTION, not the repricing. Gap WITH a mature swing to a fresh cum-extreme -> Monday FADES it (1109 +1560 -> 1110 -820; 0908 +460 -> faded +740->+190). Gap at a FRESH turn (<=~2 sessions old) -> Monday EXTENDS (1019 +1570 -> 1020 +2660). No material gap -> Monday carries FRIDAY's side (1107->1110, 1114->1117 G7; 0919->0922 G3; 1017->1020 G5). Monday bigness stands; Monday-as-block-reversal is retired (the G3-5 'reversals' were swing-state coincidences).
reasoning_method.giveback_origin_shelf_floor: R5 (S96.2): a terminal give-back runs until it retraces to the swing's ORIGIN/consolidation shelf, then stabilizes (give-back-not-reversal). At >=~75% retrace of the swing, the R1 closes-at-low continuation read INVERTS: capitulation closes at stretched extremes precede the BOUNCE (0922->0923 +610 G3; 1016->1017 +740 G5; 1117->1118 +270 G7; also 1029 stall -> 1030 +2580 G6 as the Thursday-turn form). Mechanism: the give-back unwinds the crowd that entered during the extension; once price returns to where the extension began there is no trapped inventory left to force further. Use for give-back sizing (floor) and for calling the stabilization/turn day. S98.2 CAVEAT: the shelf floor holds only for NON-parabolic give-backs (G7). After a confirmed polarity flip off a parabolic run the shelf is VOID and breaks (1211 through 4.367) - the break itself is the flip's confirmation.
reasoning_method.chain_polarity: S98.2 + S99.2 HARDENED (the G9+G10 lessons, load-bearing): every sequencing rule is POLARITY-RELATIVE - 'resume' means resume the RUNNING chain's direction, and BANDS are polarity-relative too (ramp-shallow give-backs belong to up-chains; a live cold ramp in a down-chain is the COUNTER catalyst - it feeds 1-2 day bounces and full crash-band days when they die: 0114). The polarity flips ONLY at a confirmed structure.chain_polarity_flip passing the HARDENED four-condition bar (band-break >=1.5x + old-side continuation-collapse in the actual tape + printed-not-front-run + the catalyst-arbiter/backdrop check) - a strong in-band bounce is NEVER a flip (0107, 1217, 1223-as-birth). TERMINATION does not equal BIRTH: without a forward fundamental driver a terminated chain enters the POST-PARABOLIC BLEED at the old polarity (see structure.post_parabolic_bleed) - the down-chain 'ends' only on the tape, never in the lean, until a true confirm prints. In a flipped/down regime: cold-delivery days FAIL, bullish prints SELL (8/8), and R1's symmetric close-vs-extreme read runs the alternation - reading CHAIN-SIDE days' closes only (a counter/fade day's recovered close carries no bounce signal: 0105).
reasoning_method.post_parabolic_bleed: S99.2 (the G10 class): after a parabolic chain's termination signature fires WITHOUT a birth driver, the regime is neither trend-chain nor two-sided basing but a stepped BLEED at the old polarity: single crash days, 1-2 day bounces (never 3), post-crash pauses, more small days, marginal new lows. Sequencing: bounce-death + failed_rally_tell -> crash; crash -> pause (crashes chain only INTO a print day); print days chain-sided and, on in-chain confirmations, sized DOWN a class. The bleed persists as long as the fundamental stream keeps re-confirming the old chain (G10: the whole block).

Chain state, catalysts and all other reads operate INSIDE the class frame, never above it.
day_class_toolbags.within_class_scoring: GREG (verbatim intent): "we don't want to revert back to Mondays scoring Fridays." A day-class is forecast and SCORED only against its own class's history: Monday bands/archetypes from Mondays, Friday from Fridays, Sundays from Sundays, holidays from the same holiday (addendum_holiday_doctrine), Tue-Thu from the shared core (interchangeable is itself a class statement, not an exemption). Cross-class instances are CONTEXT/mechanism evidence only - never calibration, never a scoring baseline. Where a class's n is thin, the thinness is NAMED and carried; it is never patched with another class's data.
